note: aft_search's regex and literal route verifies every trigram candidate (bounded by files examined and time, never by matches found) and ranks whole files before the page is cut: source before other text before data, a keyword declaration of the matched name before a field line before a plain mention, then more matching lines. Each file is one result carrying its matching lines (all up to ten, else five plus a count), declaration first. A bounded pass always carries a budget envelope. Every row, including those flagged reference_not_page_invariant, must be page-invariant. grep's own path is unchanged.
